global_style: A dynamic, high-contrast presentation template featuring bold diagonal layouts, overlapping hollow frames, and a strong purple accent color, ideal for events or creative portfolios.

identity_anchors: Bold diagonal background splits and image masks
Thick, hollow rectangular and square accent frames overlapping content
Deep purple primary accent against stark white and dark navy
Prominent drop shadows creating distinct layers

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
